name: Crowley Penn Terminals - Eddystone PA
type: Marine terminal with dry + refrigerated warehouse

fieldNotes.location: Roster coords (39.853752,-75.338927) landed inside the terminal — confirmed correct. Penn Terminals at the end of Saville Avenue, Eddystone PA, on the Delaware River. Confirmed via satellite (warehouses + container yard + pier) and Street View along Saville Ave (terminal warehouse, perimeter fence, historic brick Penn Terminals office building).
fieldNotes.truckGate: Marine terminal operated under MTSA/ISPS security regime — access is via a controlled gate at the east end of Saville Avenue. Street View coverage ended at the warehouse before the gate itself, so the gate structure was not directly imaged; marked uncertain. Chain-link perimeter fencing visible in multiple Street View frames.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Inferred from MTSA-regulated marine terminal access control; the Penn Terminals office sits at the entrance and an escort/check-in process is documented (escort fee paid at the terminal entrance). Not directly imaged — marked uncertain.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long ~300,000 sq ft dry warehouse with a continuous bank of dock doors on its NW face; trailers/containers backed in confirm dock positions. Counted ~35; band 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive container and chassis storage across the open terminal yard — hundreds of containers/trailers in stacks and rows.
fieldNotes.railServed: Rail line and rail yard run along the north edge of the terminal; rail tracks cross Saville Avenue at the terminal entrance (visible in Street View). Penn Terminals is rail-served.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus: dry warehouse, refrigerated warehouse, multiple ancillary buildings, pier, large container yard.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Saville Avenue is a long approach road dedicated to the terminal; ample queue room before the gate.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Not directly imaged; estimated single in/out lane at the gate — low confidence.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly identified; flagged uncertain.

citations.claim: The Eddystone PA marine terminal at 1 Saville Ave is operated as PSA Penn Terminals, an independent terminal operator.
Penn Terminals Inc. joined the PSA Group in Aug 2019, renamed PSA Penn Terminals; active independent operator as of 2025.
Crowley lists the Eddystone address as 'Penn Terminals, Inc.' - a port of call naming Penn Terminals as the operating entity, not Crowley.

verification.rationale: Different operator: PSA Penn Terminals (independent) runs this terminal; Crowley only calls here as a carrier and operates no yard at the address.

recoveredFrom.note: verification restored from the pre-overwrite record; identity reconciled by site id + coordinates
